sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.
Juggling anteater coming up — building your animated SVG.

arguments.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="450" viewBox="0 0 600 450">
<style>
  .outline { stroke:#333; stroke-width:3; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
  .bottle { stroke:#333; stroke-width:2.5; }
</style>
<rect width="600" height="450" fill="#cdeffd" rx="20"/>
<ellipse cx="300" cy="420" rx="250" ry="18" fill="#000" opacity="0.1"/>
<!-- ground -->
<rect y="400" width="600" height="50" fill="#8fd18f"/>
<g>
  <!-- moving background clouds -->
  <g fill="white" opacity="0.9">
    <ellipse cx="100" cy="80" rx="45" ry="20"/>
    <ellipse cx="130" cy="70" rx="35" ry="18"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0 0" to="400 0" dur="18s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
</g>

<!-- WHOLE RIDER GROUP bobbing -->
<g>
  <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -10; 0 0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  <!-- unicycle wheel -->
  <g transform="translate(300,340)">
    <circle r="55" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="8"/>
    <circle r="8" fill="#555"/>
    <g>
      <line x1="-50" y1="0" x2="50" y2="0" stroke="#888" stroke-width="4"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="-50" x2="0" y2="50" stroke="#888" stroke-width="4"/>
      <line x1="-35" y1="-35" x2="35" y2="35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="4"/>
      <line x1="-35" y1="35" x2="35" y2="-35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="4"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- frame + seat -->
    <rect x="-5" y="-110" width="10" height="60" fill="#e63946"/>
    <rect x="-30" y="-120" width="60" height="12" rx="6" fill="#222"/>
    <!-- pedals/cranks rotating opposite feel -->
    <g>
      <line x1="-22" y1="0" x2="22" y2="0" stroke="#222" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect x="-30" y="-5" width="16" height="10" rx="3" fill="#222"/>
      <rect x="14" y="-5" width="16" height="10" rx="3" fill="#222"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- anteater body -->
  <g transform="translate(300,230)">
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d="M -60 20 Q -110 10 -125 -40 Q -90 -20 -55 -5 Z" fill="#a67c52" class="outline">
      <animate attributeName="d" values="M -60 20 Q -110 10 -125 -40 Q -90 -20 -55 -5 Z; M -60 20 Q -115 25 -135 -10 Q -95 -5 -55 -5 Z; M -60 20 Q -110 10 -125 -40 Q -90 -20 -55 -5 Z" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </path>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="70" ry="45" fill="#c49a6c" class="outline"/>
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="5" rx="40" ry="28" fill="#e8dcc3" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- stripes -->
    <path d="M -10 -42 L 25 -20 L 10 30 L -25 10 Z" fill="#333" opacity="0.85"/>
    <path d="M -5 -38 L 15 -25 L 5 20 L -15 8 Z" fill="white" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- legs to pedals -->
    <path d="M -10 35 L -20 90 L 0 90" fill="none" stroke="#8a5f3d" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M 20 35 L 25 90 L 5 90" fill="none" stroke="#8a5f3d" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="d" values="M 20 35 L 25 90 L 5 90; M 20 35 L 10 90 L -10 90; M 20 35 L 25 90 L 5 90" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </path>
    <!-- long snout head -->
    <g>
      <path d="M 50 -15 L 145 -5 L 145 15 L 50 15 Z" fill="#c49a6c" class="outline"/>
      <circle cx="148" cy="5" r="8" fill="#333"/>
      <circle cx="70" cy="-5" r="6" fill="#222"/>
      <circle cx="72" cy="-6" r="2" fill="white"/>
      <!-- ear -->
      <ellipse cx="45" cy="-35" rx="10" ry="16" fill="#a67c52" class="outline"/>
      <!-- tongue flick -->
      <line x1="155" y1="5" x2="175" y2="5" stroke="#ff6b8a" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
        <animate attributeName="x2" values="175;195;175" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </line>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-4 50 0; 4 50 0; -4 50 0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- juggling arms -->
    <g stroke="#8a5f3d" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
      <path d="M 0 -10 Q -40 -40 -60 -70">
        <animate attributeName="d" values="M 0 -10 Q -40 -40 -60 -70; M 0 -10 Q -30 -50 -20 -80; M 0 -10 Q -40 -40 -60 -70" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <path d="M 10 -10 Q 50 -40 70 -70">
        <animate attributeName="d" values="M 10 -10 Q 50 -40 70 -70; M 10 -10 Q 40 -50 30 -80; M 10 -10 Q 50 -40 70 -70" dur="0.9s" begin="0.45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
    </g>
    <circle cx="-60" cy="-70" r="9" fill="#8a5f3d">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="-60;-20;-60" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="-70;-80;-70" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="70" cy="-70" r="9" fill="#8a5f3d">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="70;30;70" dur="0.9s" begin="0.45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="-70;-80;-70" dur="0.9s" begin="0.45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- JUGGLED BOTTLES (3) parabolic arcs -->
  <g>
    <!-- bottle shape def -->
    <g id="bottle" class="bottle">
      <rect x="-12" y="-25" width="24" height="50" rx="8" fill="#7ddf64"/>
      <rect x="-6" y="-35" width="12" height="12" fill="#4aa33c" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <rect x="-12" y="-10" width="24" height="10" fill="white" opacity="0.6"/>
      <text x="0" y="12" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="bold" fill="#2a6b22">ANTEATER</text>
    </g>
    <use href="#bottle" transform="translate(240,120)">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="240 160; 300 40; 360 160" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </use>
    <use href="#bottle" transform="translate(360,120)">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="360 160; 300 40; 240 160" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </use>
    <use href="#bottle" transform="translate(300,60)">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="300 40; 240 160; 360 160; 300 40" keyTimes="0;0.33;0.66;1" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </use>
  </g>
</g>

<text x="300" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="bold" font-size="22" fill="#333">Anteater Unicycler & Bottle Juggler!</text>
</svg>

content.text:
Created animated SVG at `anteater-unicycle.svg`:

- Anteater with long snout, tongue flick, striped shoulder, wagging tail
- Spinning unicycle wheel + pedals, bobbing rider
- 3 green bottles juggling in parabolic arcs (SMIL animation)
- Bouncing ground shadow, drifting cloud, title

Open it in a browser to see the animation (SMIL - works in Chrome/Firefox/Safari).
